name: gp-param-issue
prompt: In server/src/gameplan.rs replace the body of `pub fn param_issue` (currently `todo!()`). `p` is the workflow parameter definition and `v` the value the plan gives it. Return None when the value fits and Some(message) otherwise. By `p.kind`: "number": the value must be a JSON number (`v.as_f64()`), else Some(format!("Parameter {} must be a number.", p.name)); when `p.min` is Some(m) and the number is below m, or `p.max` is Some(m) and the number is above m, return Some(format!("Parameter {} must be between {} and {}.", ...)) using the limits that are set (use the word "between {min} and {max}" with the missing side written as "-" ). "choice": the value must be a string that is in `p.choices`, else Some(format!("Parameter {} must be one of {}; \"{}\" is not allowed.", p.name, p.choices.join(", "), <the value as text: the string itself, or its JSON text when it is not a string>)). "text": the value must be a JSON string, else Some(format!("Parameter {} must be text.", p.name)). Any other kind: None. Limits are allowed (inclusive). Change nothing else.
